title: Generate a fresh working ICP0 public URL and update deployment/indexing docs

requirements.text: Create a fresh Internet Computer deployment that produces a new working public URL in the format `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` (not `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/`), and record the newly generated working URL as the build output (i.e., it must be discoverable in-repo as the latest deployment URL).

quotes: Generate a fresh working ICPO public link

acceptanceCriteria: A new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL is produced for the app and is reachable in an incognito/private window.
Loading the new URL shows the Campus Point Services homepage (no 'Canister ID Not Resolved' / gateway error).
The latest deployment URL is written into `frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md` (replacing the placeholder `[TO BE FILLED BY DEPLOYMENT SYSTEM]`).

requirements.text: Update `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` to replace `[NEW URL TO BE GENERATED]` with the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and reflect that it is the current live deployment (while keeping the previous broken URL listed as deprecated).

quotes: Generate a fresh working ICPO public link

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` contains the new working URL under 'Public URL' and no longer contains the placeholder string.
The deprecated URL `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` remains documented as 'Previous URL (deprecated)'.
Any sitemap example in `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` uses the new URL (e.g., `[NEW_URL]/sitemap.xml`).

requirements.text: Update `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` so the 'Your Live Website URL' section includes the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and references the correct sitemap URL for that deployment.

quotes: Generate a fresh working ICPO public link

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` includes the new working URL under 'Your Live Website URL'.
The guide references the sitemap at the new deployment (e.g., `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml`).

requirements.text: Ensure Open Graph `og:url` metadata is set to the actual deployed origin at runtime by invoking `updateRuntimePublicUrl()` on app startup (without modifying immutable files), and remove production debug logging from `frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts`.

quotes: Generate a fresh working ICPO public link

acceptanceCriteria: On first app render, the document `meta[property="og:url"]` content is updated to match `window.location.origin + '/'` (e.g., `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/`).
`frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts` no longer logs the runtime URL via `console.log`.
No changes are made to immutable path `frontend/src/main.tsx`.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI library sources must be composed, not edited).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; only add `backend/migration.mo` if an upgrade requires state migration.
nonGoals: Fix or restore the broken vanity domain `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` mapping itself (the goal is to produce and document a new working `*.icp0.io` canister URL).
Add new product features unrelated to generating a fresh working public URL and updating the related documentation/metadata.
